en.title: Virginia passes movie theater accessibility law; NYC funds subway elevators
en.summary: Virginia has enacted legislation requiring movie theaters to provide captioning, audio description, and wheelchair-accessible seating for patrons with disabilities. New York City will use congestion pricing revenue to install elevators at five Brooklyn subway stations, improving wheelchair access. Additionally, Cowans Gap State Park now offers tactile maps, audio guides, and wheelchair‑friendly trails for visitors with disabilities.

zh-TW.title: 弗吉尼亞通過電影院無障礙法；紐約市擬裝電梯提升地鐵無障礙
zh-TW.summary: 弗吉尼亞州已通過立法，要求電影院提供字幕、聲音描述及輪椅可及座位，以改善殘障觀眾的觀影體驗。紐約市將利用擁擠費收入，在布碌崙五個地鐵站安裝電梯，提升輪椅使用者的可及性。此外，Cowans Gap 州立公園推出觸覺地圖、語音導覽及輪椅友善步道等無障礙工具；帕克城獲 Wheel the World 無障礙驗證；同時，一則來自日本的推文示範影片描述如何協助盲人或低視力觀眾。
